rationale: Price is sitting at 78% of today's range near $34.23, above VWAP ($33.99) and the 9-EMA ($34.06), but the last five 1-minute candles show a tight, low-volume consolidation with no clear directional momentum — volume is decelerating sharply (22k→3k).
